card.name: Per-unit and frequency words after doses
card.fires_on: The slash or word right after a dose amount that starts the 'per' part of a rate, such as /kg, /meal, once or every after mg or mEq. It also fires on the 1 in 1.73 m2.

modes.label: Per-kg slash
modes.description: The /kg part of a weight-based dose right after a unit such as mg, mEq, mcg or lipase units.
modes.example: The dosage should be increased by 5 mg<</kg>>/week to 10 mg/kg

modes.label: Frequency word after dose
modes.description: A word like once or every placed after a dose amount to give how often it is taken.
modes.example: 15 mg<< every>> other day 5 mg once daily

modes.label: Rate denominator
modes.description: The 1 or slash inside a rate denominator such as mL/min/1.73 m2 or mg/9 hours.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that complete a 'one per' type rate or interval, and away from the word 'one' itself.
card.plain: It marks the spot after a dose amount where 'per kg' or 'every so often' begins.
